name: Kitta Kaede
source:
Sakurakage Gakuen High School sophomore.
Naoto Sunahara was in the same class when he was in junior high school, and in junior high school he had excellent grades and was popular with both men and women. After graduating, he went on to a high-level high school in the neighboring town, Sakurakage Gakuen High School, but he happened to meet Naoto Sunahara again and became a member of the AI ​​Research Department.
